def factor_intraday_reversion_volume_scaled(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    past_intraday_ret = intraday_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    vol5 = intraday_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).std()
    vol20 = intraday_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    vol_ratio = vol5 / vol20.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    raw_factor = -past_intraday_ret * vol_ratio
    vol_ema = df_copy["volume"].ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean()
    volume_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ema.replace(0, np.nan)
    volume_ratio = volume_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(0.2, 5.0)
    factor = raw_factor * volume_ratio
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_intraday_reversion_volume_scaled"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_reversion_volume_scaled"]
description: Mutation of parent factor_volume_scaled_meanreversion_ema. The core mechanism is mean-reversion amplified by short-term volatility spike and scaled by continuous volume intensity. Preservation target: robust IC and RankIC from volume-scaled mean-reversion. Mutation: replace the close-to-close return in the reversion leg with intraday return from alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday. Intraday returns isolate the speculative intraday component, which may exhibit sharper mean-reversion when realized volatility spikes. Volatility ratios are also computed on intraday returns for consistency. This aims to improve MI and signal stability without altering the economic structure.
